sections.decision: USBR documents below-dam access, but its general recreation map does not identify a dependable landing coordinate. Existing 9-mile figure also needs review.
sections.nextAction: Locate the below-dam river launch from a detailed USBR facility map, then reconcile river miles. Do not use the dam or a reservoir launch.

sections.decision: Tourism park coordinate lies about 31 m from USBR’s diversion-dam coordinate. Candidate rejected. FWP line also disagrees with the 10-mile catalog value.
sections.nextAction: Obtain an upstream landing/park plan from USBR. Keep the dam coordinate out of the access registry.

sections.decision: Stevensville Bridge identified as John & Nancy Owen FAS. FWP documents boat access. Facility marker accepted; exact ramp unconfirmed.
sections.nextAction: Review the local map; retain approximate marker. Dotted route awaits exact landings/centerline review.

sections.decision: Same Owen alias resolved. FWP line is about 10.05 mi versus legacy 9 mi; no automatic mileage substitution.
sections.nextAction: Review map and obtain independently reviewed landing-to-landing miles before restoring timing.

sections.decision: No current operating boat-access record found for the intended Buckhouse Bridge take-out.
sections.nextAction: Check Missoula/MDT bridge-access ownership and identify an actual authorized landing; a bridge or road polygon is insufficient.

sections.decision: City documents Silver Park as a take-out. Caras Park remains an unconfirmed raft landing.
sections.nextAction: Investigate replacing this trip with Sha-Ron–Silver Park; map the city landing and measure that different route before replacing endpoints.

sections.decision: City identifies Silver Park as last public exit before the Grass Valley diversion, with Kelly Island below it.
sections.nextAction: Do not release as a casual city float. Define a separate upstream-of-dam trip and proper exit before changing the catalog.

sections.decision: County minutes identify Wild Cat / Edgar Bridge access at East Pryor Road; not found in current FWP point inventory.
sections.nextAction: Retrieve the county/FWP acquisition or as-built ramp map and current operating status; a name match alone cannot produce a landing pin.

sections.decision: RMS trip plan locates Highway 287 bridge launch and Mid Canon FAS, including about one mile on the Missouri. Old launch/takeout descriptions corrected.
sections.nextAction: Review corrected local map. Keep old section ID for links, but old calibration is disabled; a future centerline must follow two joined rivers.

sections.decision: Survey distinguishes campground/pull-out and Upper/Lower Storm Castle. Greek Creek restoration completed in 2025 changes bank/access. Survey totals 5.2 or 7.3 mi, not 9.
sections.nextAction: The 2025 restoration added a low-impact rock terrace, not documented trailer ramp access. USFS GIS point is a campground centroid. Establish the designated raft launch and choose Upper or Lower Storm Castle explicitly; do not use that campground coordinate as an exact landing.

sections.decision: Historical agency guide lists Shedd’s Bridge closed for unstable bank; no current reopening or equivalent replacement established.
sections.nextAction: Obtain a current managing-agency reopening or choose a separately documented take-out and remeasure the new trip.

sections.decision: Parsons/Waterloo identity now resolved, and canoe-trail owner documents ramp/right-of-way and portage. Landing by diversion remains unlocated.
sections.nextAction: Map the ramp and legal portage together from owner/county plans; obtain current condition evidence before releasing.

sections.decision: Waterloo ramp identity resolved; diversion geometry and Parrot Castle usable boat landing remain unresolved.
sections.nextAction: Resolve both landing/dam relationships, not just a bridge pin; consider a documented alternative trip if Parrot Castle is unsuitable.

sections.decision: Accepted named canoe-launch facility from interagency inventory, corroborated against BLM fairgrounds description. Rejected conflicting UTM guide value. Judith remains a facility-area marker.
sections.nextAction: Review approximate map. Dotted centerline stays a research candidate until exact launch/landing review; retain BLM 88.5 mi.

sections.decision: Bitterroot Flat / Dalles combines different locations. A campground or rapid is not an identified boat put-in.
sections.nextAction: Choose one legal launch and get the specific river-side access; recompute the intended trip to Harry’s Flat.

sections.decision: Landing remains unresolved; USFS now lists a 2026 vehicle closure on Gilbert Creek Road affecting Valley of the Moon bridge access.
sections.nextAction: Confirm landing and current road order before any shuttle plan. Do not republish the old across-road pin.

sections.decision: Same Valley of the Moon closure; confluence is not a documented road-accessible boat take-out.
sections.nextAction: Identify a usable lower exit with the land manager, then confirm vehicle access and river route.

sections.decision: PacifiCorp maps a reservoir hand access above the dam and a separate Kearney Rapids boat launch. Bigfork boat ramp below Wild Mile is not an alternative.
sections.nextAction: Define the actual lake-outlet launch and choose a named upstream take-out; prefer assessing Kearney Rapids before the reservoir/dam and remeasure that changed trip.

sections.decision: Brogan’s closure assessment says the site cannot be safely rebuilt and identifies Cinnabar separately. Queen of the Waters still lacks a confirmed suitable launch. Existing Gardiner–Corwin listing remains held.
sections.nextAction: Confirm an open Gardiner-area public launch and open downstream take-out, not tourism/OSM aliases; then define the actual trip.

sections.decision: Replaced ambiguous Corwin/Brogan’s launch with a separate Cinnabar USFS facility ID. FWP documents boating access; USFS supplies the approximate facility location. Carbella remains approximate. Old 7-mile estimate held.
sections.nextAction: Review the local Cinnabar–Carbella facility map and source actual landing-to-landing mileage. No route line, bank claim or time estimate is enabled.
